'''2014 MPC Holotable Greg Shaw DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Holotable).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)|VB2-D-imperialoccupation-pre.gif|label=Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Holotable
